note: BLM campground on the banks of the North Platte River below Bennett Peak, at 7,200 ft: from Riverside, WY-230 east 4 miles, then 12 miles of gravel County Road 660 and 7 miles on BLM Road 3404. Sandy tent pads; trout fishing and floating. --Claude

Sites, facilities, season, booking (FCFS), fees written; note trimmed to agency facts. Riverfront not supportable with named sites - downgrade lead.
